assets: the flow metrics and the throughput measure (merged PRs per hour)
the budgets, the SLOs and their tighten-only rule
the census and its hash-chained records
boundaries: main's history and the metrics read from it
a pull request that changes a budget or a measure
a session transcript and the usage read from it

threats.statement: Merge envelopes, empty or fix-up commits are counted as delivered work, so the measure reports throughput that did not happen.
A change loosens a budget or an SLO, or grows the exception list, to make a measure pass.
A census record is edited or removed so the measure's history no longer shows what it held.
A measure or a usage report copies a secret or a transcript's private content into the repository.
A measure that reads all of history grows without bound and stalls the gate stage that runs it. Residual: the gate's ceiling only warns; a slow stage is stopped by the job's timeout.

A measure is read as a decision, so a wrong number steers the fronts without an owner's decision. Residual: the measures inform the manager; nothing in the tree stops a session from acting on a wrong one.

findings.finding: REQ-gate-60s and the 180 s ceiling are targets; the ceiling only warns (D-064 f).
findings.reason: the job timeout (tower-gate.yml) added; residual added.

findings.finding: STD-measurement-checks keeps budgets from loosening; it does not stop a wrong number from steering the fronts. No stronger reference exists in the tree.
findings.reason: reference removed; the residual, already honest, carries the threat with D-294.
